fields.english:
Lily Pads let non-aquatic plants grow on top of them.
Traits: Aquatic, short, platform.
Special: Placing one of the following plants on top changes its appearance and abilities:
• Sunflower, Wall-nut, Fume-shroom, Threepeater, Squash, Torchwood or Jalapeno: Every 90s, attempts to produce the corresponding plant on top.
• Doom-shroom: Cannot be selected with tools such as the Shovel or Glove. Immune to damage and does not block zombies. Cannot change to another appearance. Kills plants placed on top, except Doom-shroom and cursed plants. Becomes productive 90s after appearing. Every 1s, all productive Lily Pads with this appearance collectively have a 0.5% chance to produce a Doom-shroom. A Doom-shroom effect that attempts to create a crater in water creates a Lily Pad with this appearance instead.
fields.origin: Context-aware translation of actual Android 4.1 source; verified Blooms names and terms

Gatling Cherrybomber fires four explosive cherries per round.
Usage Condition: Buy its recipe in Odyssey Mode.
Fusion Recipe: Gatling Cherry + Explode-o-shooter
Damage: 300×4/1.5s
Special: Immune to Cherry explosions. Explosive cherries deal splash damage in a 1-tile radius without falloff.

Explosive cherries count twice toward its production of explosive plants and, when passing through, grant it a damage bonus of [Gatling Cherrybomber count × 0.1%].

fields.english:
Cherrizilla is a frontline fighter that combines attack and defense and loves Cherry explosions.
Usage Condition: Buy its recipe in Odyssey Mode.
Fusion Recipe: Cherry Chomper + Chompzilla
Toughness: 8000. Damage per hit capped at 1/3 of Toughness.
Damage: Bite 1000/1.75s; projectile 300/1.75s.
Trait: Tall.
Special: Resists crushing. Health can reach 4 times Toughness; excess health drains at 10% Toughness per 1s. Immune to Cherry explosion damage; Cherry explosion effects heal 200 HP.
Bites all zombies within 1.5 tiles ahead. Adds damage equal to (3 + 0.2 × devour stacks)% of zombie Toughness. In Odyssey: Evolved, instead increases bite damage by (5 × devour stacks)%. Heals for damage dealt and spits explosive cherries.
A bite can devour even giant zombies, or deal instant-kill damage to Mini-bosses. This restores health equal to 4 times Toughness and grants 1 devour stack, then requires 40s digestion.
On lethal damage, health cannot drop below 1 from damage for 5s. This has a 10s cooldown and starts on cooldown.
Modifier 1: Healing ×3.
Modifier 2: Digestion time becomes 15s.
Synergy Modifier: While Cherrizilla or its subspecies and Obsidian Tall-nut or its subspecies are both present, the former has uncapped health and the latter gains 90% damage reduction.
fields.origin: Context-aware translation of actual Android 4.1 source; verified Blooms names and terms

Midas Umbrella excels at bouncing and strengthening lobbed projectiles.
Usage Condition: Odyssey Mode.
Fusion Recipe: Alchemist Umbrella + Umbrella Kale
Toughness: 4000
Special: Catches lobbed projectiles from behind, increases their damage by 100%, and redirects them to the nearest enemy ahead or behind in its own or adjacent lanes. Tridents treat it as their nearest target within range, and deal 75% less damage to it. Zombies knocked back in its lane move to a random lane.

Ultimate: Costs 1000 Coins; cooldown 7.5s. Uses Alchemist Umbrella's Ultimate, with silver/gold statue conversion thresholds raised from 25%/10% HP to 50%/20% HP.
Modifier 1: Projectile damage bonus rises from 100% to 300%.
Modifier 2: Uses its Ultimate for free when zombies approach; unlocks Aegis Umbrella.

fields.english:
Garlizilla combines frontline attack and defense with Garlic traits.
Subspecies of Cherrizilla.
Usage Condition: Buy its recipe in Odyssey Mode.
Conversion Recipe: Cherry Bomb ↔ Garlic.
Toughness: 8000. Damage per hit capped at 1/3 of Toughness.
Damage: Bite 1000/1.75s; projectile 300/1.75s.
Trait: Tall.
Special: Resists crushing. Health can reach 4 times Toughness; excess health drains at 10% Toughness per 1s. Immune to Cherry explosion damage.
Bites all zombies within 1.5 tiles ahead. Adds damage equal to (3 + 0.2 × devour stacks)% of zombie Toughness. In Odyssey: Evolved, instead increases bite damage by (5 × devour stacks)%. Heals for damage dealt. Its explosive cherries add 1 Garlic value and inflict Poison on zombies in range.
A bite can devour even giant zombies, or deal instant-kill damage to Mini-bosses. This restores health equal to 4 times Toughness and grants 1 devour stack, then requires 40s digestion.
On lethal damage, health cannot drop below 1 from damage for 5s. This has a 10s cooldown and starts on cooldown.
Modifier 1: Healing ×3.
Modifier 2: Digestion time becomes 15s.
Synergy Modifier: While Cherrizilla or its subspecies and Obsidian Tall-nut or its subspecies are both present, the former has uncapped health and the latter gains 90% damage reduction.

fields.english:
Astro-nut opens Ultimate Black Holes to restrain zombies and absorb projectiles.
Subspecies of Cosmo-pult.
Usage Condition: Buy its recipe in Odyssey Mode.
Conversion Recipe: Kernel-pult ↔ Wall-nut.
Toughness: 16000. Damage per hit capped at 1000.
Special: Resists crushing. Click to open an Ultimate Black Hole in place or switch between automatic and manual creation. Opening one grants a shield equal to 1 times Toughness, followed by a 16s cooldown.
Ultimate Black Hole: Grants its creator 20% damage reduction. Absorbing a projectile shares shield equal to 12% of projectile damage among all Astro-nuts with open Black Holes, capped at 1 times Toughness, and refreshes Black Hole duration. Damage radius: 2.2 tiles. Collapse spends 1/3 of the creator's shield and deals 3 times the amount spent, or 10 times to zombies biting the creator.
After each near-death event or loss of shield equal to 0.5 times Toughness, rewinds HP and shield to 3s earlier, then restores HP equal to 0.5 times Toughness and shield equal to 1 times Toughness. This has a 10s cooldown, during which it gains 33% damage reduction.
Modifier 1: Opening a Black Hole grants 33% damage reduction.
Modifier 2: Doubles Ultimate Black Hole duration and maximum lifetime.

SP Gatling Doom fires Irradiated Shells that add effects based on the target's debuffs.
Promoted form of Gatling Doom.
Usage Condition: Buy its modifier in Odyssey Mode after obtaining both modifiers of its base form.
Fusion Recipe: Gatling Doom (base) + Doom-shroom.
Damage: 300×4/1.5s
Special: Every 16th shell becomes a large shell dealing 6 times damage, followed by a 4.5s rest, equal to 3 attack intervals.
Shells add one effect based on the target's state:
• Chilled: Freezes for 1s and makes this hit deal ×4 damage.
• Enflamed: Instead triggers an Enflamed explosion dealing the same damage.
• Poisoned: Before the hit, adds damage equal to projectile attack ×0.5×Garlic value.
Irradiated Shells: Inflict Irradiated and pierce Type 2 armor. Large shells cause 2 area hits in a 3-tile radius.
Modifier 1: No rest after firing.
Modifier 2: Every 4th shell becomes a large Doom Shell.

fields.english:
Fungularity uses Doom Energy to erase space-time, leaving icy currents to sweep away survivors.
Subspecies of Maelonstorm.
Usage Condition: Buy its recipe in Odyssey Mode.
Conversion Recipe: Melon-pult ↔ Doom-shroom.
Damage: 3600 (Ash)
Special: Does not explode automatically. Clicking selects a detonation point. Detonation releases a Doom-shroom effect. Zombies already teleporting have their elapsed waiting time increased by [explosion damage] seconds; others receive 4s of Teleport. Temporarily freezes level progression, delaying the next wave, and creates 5 pairs of vertical portals around the explosion for 4s.
Starts at energy level 1. Using a Doom-shroom card on it raises the energy level.
Level 1: 1 space-time ice current per portal pair; freezes level progression for 1s.
Level 2: Explosion damage ×3; 2 currents; freezes progression for 3s.
Level 3: Explosion damage ×3; 5 currents; freezes progression for 10s. Deals 10 times attack damage to the highest-HP zombie on the detonation tile and applies 30s Teleport without increasing elapsed waiting time. Refunds 1 Maelonstorm card. This unstable level explodes in place after 10s.
Space-time ice currents deal 10 damage every 0.02s to touching zombies, inflicting Chill and 1s Teleport. Can hit airborne enemies. When disappearing with their portals, deal Ash damage within 1.5 tiles and freeze for 10s.
Modifier 1: Creates only one portal pair, but ice current count ×10.
Modifier 2: Bosses and Mini-bosses immune to Teleport still lose HP equal to (Teleport duration)%.

Subspecies of Tycoonwood.

Lumos: Level 3 within 5×5 tiles.

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>Artsy Sunflower graduated from Sunshine University's art department. Her use of empty space made her famous in abstract art. "Blank space holds endless possibilities," she said in an interview. "A painting may stay the same to its artist, but a thousand plants see a thousand different 花木蕾藤."</color>
fields.source: <color=#3D1400>画家向日葵毕业于阳光大学艺术系，因她著名的她留白画法闻名于整个抽象派艺术领域。“空白代表着无限的可能，”画家向日葵在访谈中说道，“即使画在画家眼中的本质不变，但一千株植物的眼中也有一千条花木蕾藤。”</color>
fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Painter Sunflower graduated from the Department of Art at Sunshine University and is renowned throughout the abstract art field for her famous negative-space painting style. "Blank space represents infinite possibilities," painter Sunflower said in an interview, "Even if the essence seen through a painter's eyes remains unchanged, in the eyes of a thousand plants, there are a thousand tangled vines and budding flowers."</color>

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>昔有老匠，入深山斫竹，备元日爆竹之需。自忖疾久，此殆毕生绝响，遂择千年老竹，填以丹砂，匠心独运。及岁除，燃其引，烬尽而竹寂。匠怅然，方阖目，竹忽冲霄而起，周身烈焰，长啸而去，其声若凤鸣，亦如龙啸。乡人莫不惊异，匠亦欣然色喜，疾遂愈。</color>

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>磁力窝瓜是武术学院的教练，他从事这份工作已经有二十年了，无数学员在他的教导下学会了泰山压顶这门绝技，包括兵器架上的铁器。</color>

fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Magnet Squash is a coach at the martial arts academy, having honed in his skills for twenty years. Countless trainees have learned the ultimate technique under his guidance, "Mount Tai Pressure Points". Including the iron weapons on the weapon rack.</color>

fields.previous: 保护伞窝瓜
fields.source: 保护伞窝瓜
fields.english: Umbrella Squash

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>“我长头发了！”保护伞窝瓜兴奋地喊到，他是这里唯一一个长着浓密头发的窝瓜，但，很快就不是了，“你还我头发！！！！”保护伞窝瓜愤怒地向僵尸跳去，想要为他的头发报仇。</color>
fields.source: <color=#3D1400>“我长头发了！”保护伞窝瓜兴奋地喊到，他是这里唯一一个长着浓密头发的窝瓜，但，很快就不是了，“你还我头发！！！！”保护伞窝瓜愤怒地向僵尸跳去，想要为他的头发报仇。</color>
fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"My hair has grown!" shouted Umbrella Squash excitedly. He was the only squash here with a thick head of hair, but soon, he wouldn't be anymore. "Give me my hair back!!!!" the Umbrella Squash roared angrily as he leaped toward the zombie, determined to avenge his hair.</color>

fields.previous: 西瓜投射手
fields.source: 西瓜投射手
fields.english: Melon Pod

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>“大家都说种瓜得瓜、种豆得豆，但是我却并不这么认为。”西瓜投射手说，“我将要证明：种瓜得豆。”他非常骄傲，认为自己推翻了生物学的大厦，然而他的骄傲只持续了很短的时间，他很快发现：嫁接得到的性状无法遗传。</color>
fields.source: <color=#3D1400>“大家都说种瓜得瓜、种豆得豆，但是我却并不这么认为。”西瓜投射手说，“我将要证明：种瓜得豆。”他非常骄傲，认为自己推翻了生物学的大厦，然而他的骄傲只持续了很短的时间，他很快发现：嫁接得到的性状无法遗传。</color>
fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Everyone says that as you sow, so shall you reap. But I don't think so." said Melon Pod. "I am going to prove that planting melons will yield beans." He was very proud, believing that he had overturned the edifice of biology, but his pride lasted only a very short time; he quickly discovered that traits acquired through grafting cannot be inherited.</color>

<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>第16轮将发射器投出，造成5倍伤害。随后变回西瓜投手</color>

fields.previous: 三线胆小菇
fields.source: 三线胆小菇
fields.english: Trinity-shroom

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>三线胆小菇在第六届的胆量比赛中获得了胆小菇组的冠军。虽然他们无法通过哪怕任何一个测试关卡，但是至少，他们不会害怕自己身边的另外两个头。</color>

fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Trinity-shroom won first place for the Scaredy team at the 6th Annual Bravery Competition. Although they couldn't pass even a single test level, at least they aren't afraid of the other two heads right next to them.</color>

fields.previous: 窝瓜大喷菇
fields.source: 窝瓜大喷菇
fields.english: Crush-shroom

fields.previous: Although often reported for settling disputes physically, 窝瓜大喷菇 insists it has never laid a hand on anyone. It explains that it only sprays a few harmless spores. As for the Squash frequently seen leaping from behind it to crush others, it says those are merely hallucinations caused by inhaling the spores.
fields.source: <color=#3D1400>虽然经常被举报用物理方式解决争端，但窝瓜大喷菇坚称自己从未动过手。他解释说，自己最多只会喷出些无伤大雅的孢子，至于最常被目击到的从他背后跳出去砸人的窝瓜，他表示纯粹是吸入孢子产生的幻觉。</color>
fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Although frequently reported for physical force against others, Crush-shroom insists that he has never laid a hand on anyone. He explains that, at most, he merely puffs out some harmless spores; as for the Squashes that's most frequently witnessed leaping from behind him to smash opponents, he claims it is purely a hallucination brought on by inhaling his spores.</color>

fields.previous: 卷心菜投射手
fields.source: 卷心菜投射手
fields.english: Cabbage Pod

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>卷心菜投射手曾经担任豌豆射手的经纪人，负责安排豌豆射手的出行与采访计划、打理豌豆田的产业。不得不说他干的很不错，但是最终他还是被开除了，因为他被发现私自用卷心菜叶制作豌豆炮的周边售卖。</color>
fields.source: <color=#3D1400>卷心菜投射手曾经担任豌豆射手的经纪人，负责安排豌豆射手的出行与采访计划、打理豌豆田的产业。不得不说他干的很不错，但是最终他还是被开除了，因为他被发现私自用卷心菜叶制作豌豆炮的周边售卖。</color>
fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Cabbage Pod once served as Peashooter's manager, handling his travel and interview schedules, as well as managing his pea patch enterprise. He did a great job, but he was ultimately fired due to him secretly using cabbage leaves while making Peashooter merchandise.</color>

fields.previous: 西瓜胆小菇
fields.source: 西瓜胆小菇
fields.english: Springy-shroom

fields.previous: <color=#3D1400>“欢，欢迎来到我的家……”西瓜胆小菇缩在沙发后面欢迎客人，“那面墙是我们胆小菇家族的合照，大家都太害羞了，只能分开拍照、再拼接到一起……请不要碰那个金牌……”那是他在第十届胆小菇举重比赛上获得的金牌，他以半个西瓜的成绩取得了冠军。</color>
fields.source: <color=#3D1400>“欢，欢迎来到我的家……”西瓜胆小菇缩在沙发后面欢迎客人，“那面墙是我们胆小菇家族的合照，大家都太害羞了，只能分开拍照、再拼接到一起……请不要碰那个金牌……”那是他在第十届胆小菇举重比赛上获得的金牌，他以半个西瓜的成绩取得了冠军。</color>
fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"W-Welcome to my home..." Springy-shroom cowered behind the sofa while greeting the guest. "That wall over there has a group photo of our Scaredy-shroom family. Everyone is so shy that we had to take our pictures separately and stitch them together... Please don't touch that gold medal..." It was the gold medal he had won at the 10th Scaredy-shroom Weightlifting Competition, where he took the championship with a score of half a watermelon.</color>

fields.previous: 磁能窝瓜坚果
fields.source: 磁能窝瓜坚果
fields.english: Gravi-nut

fields.previous: 磁能窝瓜坚果 has a severe need for order. Even in battle, it cannot resist pulling projectiles onto its magnetic field lines and arranging them neatly. Zombies often complain that nothing looks more chaotic than it does. Then they get to see something even more chaotic: an enraged 磁能窝瓜坚果.
fields.source: <color=#3D1400>磁能窝瓜坚果有极其严重的强迫症，他最见不得混乱，即使在战斗中也会不由分说地把子弹拉到自己的磁感线上排列整齐。当然，经常有僵尸吐槽“没有比他的长相更混乱的东西”，然后，他们就能看到更混乱的东西：暴怒的磁能窝瓜坚果。</color>
fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Gravi-nut has an extremely severe case of OCD. He absolutely cannot stand chaos, even in the heat of battle. He will instinctively pull bullets onto his magnetic field lines and arrange them neatly. Of course, zombies often complain that "there is nothing more chaotic than his looks." At which point, they get to witness something even more chaotic: a furious Gravi-nut.</color>
